description: An RTL-SDR at 100 MHz, 1 MS/s: spectrum with RF frequencies on the x axis and a waterfall.
prompt: Tune the RTL-SDR to 100 MHz and show me the spectrum and waterfall.
needs: a SoapySDR device and its Soapy module (python SoapySDR bindings).

substitute.note: no SDR is attached to the docs machine, so `src` is a `file` block playing a generated 1 MS/s IQ file (FM carrier at -200 kHz, CW tones at +150 and +300 kHz).
